data.text: Target cannot play an action for the rest of the round; next rounds may play only Empty Posture (may destroy the permanent).

logic.description: Implemented. One enemy in contact loses the remaining actions of this turn and all actions of the next turn; the card stays in front of the caster deck as a permanent (PERM_TURNS 1) and the lock holds only while that permanent stands — destroying it under Rule 24 lifts the lock. Placed with a point-buy die as power (Rule 12). The paper "only Empty Posture" is modelled as a full lock. Aura / Aura ∀ widen the recipients.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
No declared target (the engine picks the enemy the cast hurts most within 1) or the right-clicked target is within 1 hex; through an Aura ∀ the reach is the whole view (10).
A declared target must be an enemy (exactly one side is npc_b); without one the engine aims at an enemy itself.
A declared target must still be alive (life > 0); dead units are skipped.

effects.description: The target loses the remaining actions of this turn and every action of the next turn (lock lifts if the permanent is destroyed).
Rule 12: the permanent is placed with a point-buy die (re-rolled until the sum fits); that die is its power under Rule 24.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys this permanent when it is at least the token value behind the cast element.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_time (the element family that defines the effect).
element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_souls (the element family that defines the effect).
